scenarios.boundary: Author-attested summaries derived from private authenticated runs. Public commitments can detect source-artifact drift when checked against the retained private evidence, but cannot independently prove execution.
The output is computed from the supplied JSONL event stream and must change with materially different input.
Static documentation explains evidence requirements; it is not an executed hosted-agent result.
Small synthetic JSONL inputs under tests/fixtures exercise parser behavior only and never count as campaign evidence.
